scope: One message with a cash-change clause plus one dish or order note clause, during cart building and checkout steps
baselineFindings: «sin cebolla y tráeme cambio de 50 mil» answered «No encontré *cebolla y tráeme cambio de 50 mil* en tu carrito» and stored neither the note nor the change
Leftover verbs stayed inside the note: «bien empacado y necesito», «tráeme  y que llegue rápido», «es para mi mamá y traer», «que no tenga cebolla, y llevar»
Every note was stored twice (dish note and order note) and, with several rows, silently on the last row
Order-level parts («es para mi mamá», «que llegue rápido») became dish notes
Cash stored as «vueltas de 100 mil» / «billete de 100 mil» instead of the normalized «cambio de N» used by the standalone route
fix: tryHandleMixedCashAside (early handler group, before tryHandleOrderLevelAside). Exactly one cash clause (change/vueltas/devuelta with optional verb, or «pago/llevo/tengo con billete de N» when a payment method exists) is removed with offsets mapped back to the original wording; connectors and courtesy words are stripped from the rest. Recipient, urgency and arrival/temperature parts go to customerNotes; dish modifications (sin…, que no tenga…, con poco…, bien…, packing, «X aparte») go to the named row, the only row, or the whole order when several rows are unnamed — stored once. «sin <cart dish>…», purchase/removal/change verbs, digits in the note, questions, awaiting_payment and pending selections keep their routes. Non-cash payment: the note is stored and the change is explained, not stored. State is preserved; the existing building_cart auto-advance to the summary still applies when the cart changed with a confirmed delivery address.

menus: two rows same product, different option (pizza/dough)

knownGaps: Two cash clauses or two independent notes in one message are left to existing routes
Mixed note + cash while choosing the payment method (awaiting_payment) keeps the payment route
Name change in the final step has no explicit acknowledgement
